embeds.title: 🔴 Google Leaks Details for Chromium Bug That Can Turn Browsers Into Bots
embeds.description:
An unpatched vulnerability in Chromium reported by independent researcher Lyra Rebane over three years ago allows attackers to exploit the Service Worker feature and Background Fetch API to execute JavaScript code persistently across browser restarts. The flaw can be used to hijack browsers for distributed denial-of-service attacks, run crypto miners, and perform persistent user tracking. The bug report was made public this week but then closed after Rebane reported the flaw remains unfixed.
**Sources:** CSO Online • 🔴 1 corroborating
**CVEs:** none • **Access:** Malicious website exploiting Service Worker and Background Fetch API
**Incident date:** unknown • **Confidence:** claim
